verdict.rationale: The evidence shows LocalAI can run quantized GGUF models, for example an 8-bit Q8_0 GGUF file pulled from Hugging Face, and its autoparser covers ggml/gguf models. Nothing in the pack documents the low-bit end of the range or any guidance on memory savings. Missing for 10: evidence of very low-bit (e.g. 2–4 bit) quantization support, documentation of the range of supported integer quantization levels, memory-footprint guidance or benchmarks, and independent corroboration.
